extraction_notes: No component sheet in the PDF. Every item is taken from the rules' counts (Game Pieces list on page 2, Items section on pages 3-4, Room Cards on pages 5-6, Round End Cards on page 6), so all entries are from_rules.
The Round End Cards give a count per card family, not per type. The Up/Down and Left/Right types have no printed counts, so they are not counted separately.
The four player cards each carry one item (Shovel, Torch, Teleporter, Backpack; Items section, pages 3-4). They are counted once, as player cards.
Card effect descriptions are in rules.txt, not copied into components.json.
Each of 0 unique designs (pixel-identical fronts grouped) was read by independent single-component model calls until every value had a majority; 0 designs were unanimous, 0 were resolved by hand.
Map tile shapes come from the physical tile set (8 Cross, 10 T-junction, 9 Corner, 6 Straight, 3 Dead end); the order of tiles in this file carries no meaning.
